label.zh: 与掠夺者为邻的随机事件
label.en: Random events of living next to marauders

note.zh: 每次触发从七个事件中等权抽一个；每个事件对同一帝国只发生一次，逐年可陆续遇到不同事件。
note.en: Each firing draws one of seven with equal weight; each happens once per empire, so different ones can appear over the years.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现邻国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the neighboring empire's name appears here.
